Material Symbols Rounded (res/drawable/sym_*.xml)
Copyright Google LLC. From google/material-design-icons at commit
10ecc14790612ca8fd164e3f4ffe9c16fc50d5b7,
the Rounded style, filled (FILL 1), weight 500, 24 px, as upstream ships it in
symbols/android/<name>/materialsymbolsrounded/<name>_wght500fill1_24px.xml.
